note: Declared HS 854430 (insulated wiring harnesses for vehicles/energy) does NOT match the observed trade: actual customs lines are 38229090 (laboratory reagents), 39235010 (plastic vial caps), 84713010 (laptop) — i.e. in-vitro diagnostics reagents and lab consumables, not wiring harnesses. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual code (38229090 / 39235010 as dominant) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim "Энергетика" is also inconsistent with the observed diagnostics/lab-reagent trade. Shipment reality: the company is demonstrably an ACTIVE IMPORTER (1521 shipments from Biogenex Laboratories, Fremont CA, USA — apparent group/affiliate relationship), with only ~10 outbound records, one of which is a single laptop to Hamburg. So: real customs activity confirmed, but real EXPORT shipments of own production are NOT confirmed — status declared_only, and the honest reading is 'следов экспортных поставок собственной продукции не найдено; подтверждён только импорт'. Domestic supply evidence: not found (registries out of scope, search unavailable). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source read.
